words.enDefinition: a thin clear film that guards a phone screen from scratches

examples.en: I just put a new screen protector on my phone after cracking the last one.
examples.zh: 上一个贴膜碎掉之后，我刚给手机换了张新的「屏幕保护膜」。

examples.en: The screen protector saved my screen when my phone fell off the desk.
examples.zh: 手机从桌上摔下去时，「屏幕保护膜」救了屏幕一命。

words.enDefinition: a protective cover that wraps around the back of a phone

examples.en: My phone case has a card slot, so I keep my dorm key inside it.
examples.zh: 我的「手机壳」带卡槽，所以我把宿舍钥匙放在里面。

examples.en: She bought a clear phone case so the phone color still shows through.
examples.zh: 她买了个透明「手机壳」，这样还能看到手机本来的配色。

collocations: a phone case with a card holder

words.enDefinition: the small round socket where wired headphones plug in

examples.en: My new phone has no headphone jack, so I had to buy wireless earbuds.
examples.zh: 新手机没有「耳机孔」，我只好买了无线耳机。

examples.en: The headphone jack on my laptop works better than the one on my phone.
examples.zh: 我笔记本的「耳机孔」比手机上的好用。

words.enDefinition: the small chip that connects a phone to a mobile network

examples.en: I bought a local SIM card at the airport so my phone works here.
examples.zh: 我在机场买了张本地「SIM卡」，手机在这边就能正常用了。

examples.en: My SIM card stopped working, so I have no service in my dorm.
examples.zh: 我的「SIM卡」出了问题，宿舍里完全没有信号。

words.enDefinition: the album on a phone where taken photos are stored

examples.en: My camera roll is full of food pictures from the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我的「手机相册」里全是食堂饭菜的照片。

examples.en: Can you send me the photos from last night? Mine are still in my camera roll.
examples.zh: 你能把昨晚的照片发我吗？我的还躺在「手机相册」里。

words.enDefinition: a photo you take of yourself, usually with a phone

examples.en: We took a selfie in front of the library on our first day of class.
examples.zh: 开学第一天，我们在图书馆前合拍了张「自拍」。

examples.en: The light by the window is perfect for taking a selfie.
examples.zh: 窗边的光线拍「自拍」刚刚好。

words.enDefinition: the background picture shown on a phone or computer screen

examples.en: I changed my phone wallpaper to a photo of my dog back home.
examples.zh: 我把手机「壁纸」换成了家里狗狗的照片。

examples.en: Her lock screen wallpaper is a picture of our whole dorm floor.
examples.zh: 她的锁屏「壁纸」是我们整层宿舍的合影。

words.enDefinition: the main screen of a phone where app icons appear

examples.en: I put my class schedule widget right in the middle of my home screen.
examples.zh: 我把课程表小组件放在「主屏幕」正中间。

examples.en: Swipe left on your home screen to find the app you just downloaded.
examples.zh: 在「主屏幕」上向左滑动，就能找到刚下载的应用。

collocations: add a widget to your home screen

words.enDefinition: the first screen you see before unlocking your phone

examples.en: I checked the time on my lock screen without even waking up properly.
examples.zh: 我迷迷糊糊地在「锁屏」上瞟了一眼时间。

examples.en: Her lock screen shows notifications even when the phone is locked.
examples.zh: 她的「锁屏」在手机锁定时也会显示通知。

words.enDefinition: the small picture you tap to open an app

examples.en: I accidentally deleted the app icon while rearranging my home screen.
examples.zh: 整理桌面时，我不小心删掉了一个「应用图标」。

examples.en: Long-press any app icon to see shortcuts like scanning a document.
examples.zh: 长按任意「应用图标」，就能看到扫描文档这类快捷操作。

words.enDefinition: a screen you control by tapping and swiping directly

examples.en: The touch screen stopped responding, so I could not type my password.
examples.zh: 「触摸屏」没反应了，我密码都输不了。

examples.en: Library printers still use a touch screen to select your files.
examples.zh: 图书馆的打印机还是用「触摸屏」来选文件。

words.enDefinition: the button pressed to switch a device on or off

examples.en: Hold the power button and the volume key together to restart your phone.
examples.zh: 同时按住「电源键」和音量键就能重启手机。

examples.en: The power button on my laptop is loose, so I always press it twice.
examples.zh: 我笔记本的「电源键」松了，每次都得按两下。

words.enDefinition: how loud or quiet the sound from a device is

examples.en: Turn the volume down at night so you do not wake your roommate.
examples.zh: 晚上把「音量」调小点，别吵醒室友。

examples.en: The volume on my headphones creeps up by itself during videos.
examples.zh: 看视频时，我耳机的「音量」会自己悄悄变大。

words.enDefinition: how bright or dim a screen looks to your eyes

examples.en: Lower the brightness before bed so your eyes and battery both thank you.
examples.zh: 睡前调低「亮度」，眼睛和电池都会感谢你。

examples.en: I cannot read my screen outside because the brightness is too low.
examples.zh: 户外「亮度」太低，我根本看不清屏幕。

words.enDefinition: the slot where you plug in a USB cable

examples.en: The USB port on the library computer is right next to the card reader.
examples.zh: 图书馆电脑的「USB接口」就在读卡器旁边。

examples.en: My USB port is loose, so my phone stops charging whenever I move it.
examples.zh: 我的「USB接口」松了，手机一动就断充。

words.enDefinition: the built-in storage inside a computer for all files

examples.en: My hard drive is almost full, so I moved my photos to cloud storage.
examples.zh: 我的「硬盘」快满了，所以把照片挪去了云存储。

examples.en: Back up your essays to an external hard drive before finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周之前，把论文备份到移动「硬盘」里。

collocations: back up to a hard drive

words.enDefinition: a small removable card that adds storage to devices

examples.en: I put a memory card in my camera before the field trip.
examples.zh: 实地考察出发前，我在相机里装了张「存储卡」。

examples.en: Move your videos to the memory card to free up phone storage.
examples.zh: 把视频移到「存储卡」里，给手机腾点空间。

words.enDefinition: a key combination that performs an action faster than menus

examples.en: Learning one keyboard shortcut for screenshots saves me so much time.
examples.zh: 学会一个截图「快捷键」帮我省了不少时间。

examples.en: My professor showed us a keyboard shortcut for adding citations in Word.
examples.zh: 教授教了我们一个在Word里插入文献引用的「快捷键」。

words.enDefinition: the flat sensitive panel on a laptop that replaces a mouse

examples.en: My touchpad stopped working, so I borrowed a wireless mouse from my roommate.
examples.zh: 我的「触控板」坏了，就跟室友借了个无线鼠标。

examples.en: Two-finger scrolling on the touchpad feels much faster than the arrow keys.
examples.zh: 用「触控板」双指滚动比方向键快多了。

words.enDefinition: the blinking marker that shows where you are typing

examples.en: My cursor kept jumping around while I was typing my essay.
examples.zh: 我写论文的时候「光标」总是乱跳。

examples.en: Click anywhere in the document and the cursor will move to that spot.
examples.zh: 在文档任意位置点一下，「光标」就会移到那里。

words.enDefinition: a small built-in camera on a laptop for video calls

examples.en: My webcam light turns on by itself, which honestly freaks me out.
examples.zh: 我的「摄像头」灯会自己亮起来，说实话有点吓人。

examples.en: Tape over your webcam when you are not in an online class.
examples.zh: 没在上网课的时候，用胶带把「摄像头」贴住。

words.enDefinition: the part of a device that picks up your voice

examples.en: The professor could not hear me until I allowed the site to use my microphone.
examples.zh: 直到我允许网站使用「麦克风」，教授才听得到我说话。

examples.en: My microphone sounds muffled on calls, so I clean the tiny hole with a brush.
examples.zh: 通话时我的「麦克风」声音发闷，所以我会用小刷子清理那个小孔。

words.enDefinition: a portable speaker that connects to phones without wires

examples.en: We brought a bluetooth speaker to the picnic and played our shared playlist.
examples.zh: 我们带了「蓝牙音箱」去野餐，放我们共同的歌单。

examples.en: My bluetooth speaker will not connect since I updated my phone.
examples.zh: 手机更新之后，我的「蓝牙音箱」就连不上了。

words.enDefinition: how long a device runs before needing another charge

examples.en: The update actually improved my battery life, which surprised me.
examples.zh: 这次更新居然改善了「电池续航」，挺意外的。

examples.en: Close background apps if you want better battery life during lectures.
examples.zh: 想上课时有更好的「电池续航」，就把后台应用关掉。

collocations: the battery life on this phone

words.enDefinition: a phone or laptop screen damaged with visible cracks

examples.en: I have been typing on a cracked screen since I dropped my phone at the gym.
examples.zh: 自从在健身房摔了手机，我就一直对着「碎屏」打字。

examples.en: A cracked screen still works, but the corners cut my thumb.
examples.zh: 「碎屏」还能凑合用，就是边角会割到拇指。

words.enDefinition: the amount of time spent looking at devices each day

examples.en: My weekly screen time report said nine hours a day, which was humbling.
examples.zh: 每周「屏幕使用时间」报告显示我每天玩九小时，有点扎心。

examples.en: I set app limits in screen time settings to use my phone less.
examples.zh: 我在「屏幕使用时间」设置里给应用加了限额，好少玩手机。

words.enDefinition: a flat touch-screen device bigger than a phone, smaller than a laptop

examples.en: I read lecture slides on my tablet instead of printing them out.
examples.zh: 我用「平板电脑」看课件，省得打印出来。

examples.en: My roommate takes notes on a tablet with a stylus during lectures.
examples.zh: 室友上课时用「平板电脑」加触控笔记笔记。

words.enDefinition: a wrist watch that connects to a phone and tracks activity

examples.en: My smartwatch buzzes when someone texts me during a quiet study session.
examples.zh: 安静自习时有人发消息，我的「智能手表」会轻轻震动提醒。

examples.en: He checks his sleep stats on his smartwatch every morning at breakfast.
examples.zh: 他每天吃早餐时都会在「智能手表」上看睡眠数据。

words.enDefinition: a program installed on a phone to do a particular task

examples.en: There is an app for everything here, even for booking laundry machines.
examples.zh: 这儿什么都有对应的「应用程序」，连洗衣服都能预约。

examples.en: I deleted the shopping app to stop myself from impulse buying online.
examples.zh: 我删掉了那个购物「应用」，免得网购时冲动消费。

words.enDefinition: the menu where you adjust how a device or app works

examples.en: Go into settings and turn off those annoying notification sounds.
examples.zh: 进「设置」把那些烦人的提示音关掉。

examples.en: I changed my language settings to English to practice every day.
examples.zh: 我把语言「设置」改成了英文，好每天练习。

words.enDefinition: a secret combination of characters that protects an account

examples.en: I forgot my password again and had to reset it through my email.
examples.zh: 我又忘了「密码」，只好通过邮箱重置。

examples.en: Never share your password with anyone, not even your closest roommate.
examples.zh: 别把「密码」告诉任何人，哪怕是最要好的室友。

words.enDefinition: the short number code that unlocks a phone screen

examples.en: I changed my passcode after my little cousin guessed it twice.
examples.zh: 表弟两次猜中我的「锁屏密码」，我就换了一个。

examples.en: Type your passcode to unlock the phone and hand it to me.
examples.zh: 输入「锁屏密码」解锁后，把手机递给我。

words.enDefinition: the code you need to join a wireless network

examples.en: Could you text me the wifi password before I come over to study?
examples.zh: 我过去自习之前，能先把「WiFi密码」发我一下吗？

examples.en: The cafe posts its wifi password on a little chalkboard by the counter.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把「WiFi密码」写在柜台边的小黑板上。

words.enDefinition: the unique name that identifies you when logging in

examples.en: My username for the school portal is just my student number.
examples.zh: 我学校门户的「用户名」就是我的学号。

examples.en: It says my username is already taken, which is so annoying.
examples.zh: 系统提示「用户名」已被占用，真烦人。

words.enDefinition: the small photo representing you on an app or website

examples.en: She finally changed her profile picture from a cartoon to a real photo.
examples.zh: 她终于把「头像」从卡通图换成了真人照片。

examples.en: I cropped a graduation photo to use as my new profile picture.
examples.zh: 我裁了一张毕业照，用作新的「头像」。

words.enDefinition: enter your account details to start using a website

examples.en: You have to sign in with your student ID to use the library computers.
examples.zh: 用学号「登录」之后才能使用图书馆的电脑。

examples.en: The website signs me out every time, so I sign in again each morning.
examples.zh: 这个网站总是自动退出，所以我每天早上都得重新「登录」。

collocations: sign in with your student ID

words.enDefinition: exit your account so the next user cannot access it

examples.en: Always sign out of your account on shared computers in the lab.
examples.zh: 在机房的公用电脑上用完一定要「退出登录」。

examples.en: I forgot to sign out, and my friend posted a joke from my account.
examples.zh: 我忘了「退出登录」，朋友拿我的账号发了条搞笑动态。

words.enDefinition: the saved list of people's phone numbers and emails

examples.en: I synced my contact list to my new phone in about two minutes.
examples.zh: 我花了大约两分钟就把「通讯录」同步到了新手机。

examples.en: Scroll through your contact list and delete the numbers you never call.
examples.zh: 翻翻你的「通讯录」，把从来不打的号码删掉。

collocations: add someone to your contact list

words.enDefinition: the official shop on a phone for downloading apps

examples.en: The campus map is free, just grab it from the app store.
examples.zh: 校园地图是免费的，直接去「应用商店」下载就行。

examples.en: My app store will not update anything until I agree to new terms.
examples.zh: 不同意新条款，我的「应用商店」就什么都不给更新。

words.enDefinition: remove an app completely from your phone or computer

examples.en: I uninstall games every finals season or I never get any studying done.
examples.zh: 每到考试周我就「卸载」游戏，不然根本没法学习。

examples.en: The app keeps freezing, so I uninstalled it and reinstalled the latest version.
examples.zh: 这个应用老是卡死，我把它「卸载」后重装了最新版本。

words.enDefinition: a new version that fixes problems or adds features

examples.en: My phone keeps asking for a software update, but I keep postponing it.
examples.zh: 手机一直提醒「软件更新」，我一直拖着不装。

examples.en: The software update wiped my alarm settings, so I overslept on Monday.
examples.zh: 「软件更新」清掉了我设的闹钟，周一就睡过头了。

words.enDefinition: a short alert an app sends to your lock screen

examples.en: I turned off every push notification from shopping apps to protect my wallet.
examples.zh: 我关掉了购物应用的全部「推送通知」，好守住钱包。

examples.en: You will get a push notification when your laundry is done.
examples.zh: 衣服洗好后，你会收到一条「推送通知」。

words.enDefinition: one chat where many people message everyone at once

examples.en: Our project group chat has ninety unread messages since yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 我们的项目「群聊」从昨天早上起就积了九十条未读。

examples.en: Someone added me to a group chat for the dorm floor again.
examples.zh: 又有人把我拉进了一个楼层「群聊」。

collocations: add someone to the group chat
the group chat is blowing up

words.enDefinition: an audio recording sent instead of a typed text

examples.en: My mom sends me a two-minute voice message instead of texting like everyone else.
examples.zh: 我妈不像别人那样打字，偏要给我发两分钟的「语音消息」。

examples.en: Just send me a voice message when your hands are busy cooking.
examples.zh: 你做饭腾不出手的时候，发条「语音消息」给我就行。

words.enDefinition: send a short written message to someone on their phone

examples.en: Text me when you get to the station and I will come pick you up.
examples.zh: 你到车站后「发短信」给我，我来接你。

examples.en: My landlord prefers tenants to text her rather than call about small repairs.
examples.zh: 房东更希望房客遇到小维修时「发短信」，而不是打电话。

words.enDefinition: a short written message sent from one phone to another

examples.en: I got a text message from the bank asking me to confirm my new card.
examples.zh: 我收到银行的「短信」，让我确认新卡。

examples.en: She replies to every text message within a minute, even in lectures.
examples.zh: 每条「短信」她都在一分钟内回复，上课也不例外。

words.enDefinition: a small picture used in messages to show feelings

examples.en: My professor replied to my email with a thumbs-up emoji, so I guess it was fine.
examples.zh: 教授回我邮件时用了个点赞「表情符号」，应该没问题吧。

examples.en: A single emoji can change the whole tone of a message between roommates.
examples.zh: 室友之间，一个「表情符号」就能改变整条消息的语气。

words.enDefinition: a larger cartoon image sent in chats for fun

examples.en: My grandma sends me the same cute sticker twenty times a day.
examples.zh: 我奶奶一天能给我发二十次同一个可爱「表情贴纸」。

examples.en: There is a whole sticker pack for finals week with crying cats in it.
examples.zh: 有个考试周专属的「表情贴纸」包，里面全是哭泣的猫。

words.enDefinition: send a received message on to another chat or person

examples.en: Did you remember to forward a message to the students who missed orientation?
examples.zh: 给错过迎新活动的同学「转发消息」这件事，你记着做了吗？

examples.en: You can forward a message to several chats at once by tapping the arrow.
examples.zh: 点一下箭头图标，就能一次向多个聊天「转发消息」。

collocations: forward the message from the group

words.enDefinition: the folder that holds incoming messages or emails

examples.en: My school inbox has three hundred unread emails about club events.
examples.zh: 学校「收件箱」里积了三百封社团活动的未读邮件。

examples.en: Check your inbox because the housing office replied about the room change.
examples.zh: 查一下你的「收件箱」，住宿办公室回复换房申请了。

words.enDefinition: not opened or read yet, often shown with a red badge

examples.en: I keep one unread message in each chat as a reminder to reply.
examples.zh: 每个聊天我都留一条「未读」消息，提醒自己别忘了回复。

examples.en: The little red badge says I have forty unread messages in my class group.
examples.zh: 红色小角标显示班级群里我有四十条「未读」消息。

words.enDefinition: a typing feature that silently fixes misspelled words

examples.en: Autocorrect keeps changing my roommate's name into a random word.
examples.zh: 「自动更正」总把室友的名字改成一个莫名其妙的词。

examples.en: I turned off autocorrect because it kept fixing words I typed on purpose.
examples.zh: 「自动更正」老改我故意打的词，所以我把它关了。

words.enDefinition: a small spelling mistake made while typing quickly

examples.en: There is a typo in my essay title, but the deadline is in five minutes.
examples.zh: 我的论文标题里有个「笔误」，可距离截止只剩五分钟了。

examples.en: Sorry, that was a typo — I meant Thursday, not Tuesday.
examples.zh: 抱歉，那是个「笔误」，我是想说周四，不是周二。

words.enDefinition: a typing feature that suggests whole words as you type

examples.en: Predictive text suggested my professor's full name after I typed it twice.
examples.zh: 「联想输入」在我输过两次后，自动推荐了教授的全名。

examples.en: I type so fast that predictive text guesses entire sentences for me.
examples.zh: 我打字太快，「联想输入」直接帮我猜出整句话。

words.enDefinition: online space where files are kept instead of on a device

examples.en: The university gives every student free cloud storage for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 学校给每位学生提供免费的「云存储」，用来存课堂笔记。

examples.en: My cloud storage is full, so I have to decide which photos to keep.
examples.zh: 我的「云存储」满了，得决定到底留哪些照片。

words.enDefinition: the program used to open and view websites

examples.en: My browser has forty tabs open, so my laptop sounds like a jet.
examples.zh: 我的「浏览器」开了四十个标签页，笔记本响得像喷气式飞机。

examples.en: Open the browser and search the professor's office hours instead of asking me.
examples.zh: 打开「浏览器」自己查教授的答疑时间，别来问我。

words.enDefinition: a single open page inside the browser window

examples.en: I opened a tab for every source my essay needs, and now my laptop is dying.
examples.zh: 论文要用的每份文献我都开了个「标签页」，电脑快撑不住了。

examples.en: Close that tab with the concert tickets until after your midterm.
examples.zh: 先关掉那个卖演唱会门票的「标签页」，等期中考完再说。

words.enDefinition: the box where you type words to search within a site or app

examples.en: Just type the course code into the search bar and it will pop up.
examples.zh: 把课程代码输进「搜索框」，课程信息就会弹出来。

examples.en: The search bar at the top of the app finds any building on campus.
examples.zh: 应用顶部的「搜索框」能找到校园里的任何一栋楼。

words.enDefinition: reload a page so it shows the newest content

examples.en: Refresh the page after you pay, or the order will look unfinished.
examples.zh: 付款后记得「刷新」页面，不然订单看起来像是没完成。

examples.en: I keep refreshing the grades page, but the professor has not posted them yet.
examples.zh: 我不停「刷新」成绩页面，可教授还没发布。

words.enDefinition: a clickable address that opens another page or file

examples.en: She sent me the link to the recorded lecture I missed on Friday.
examples.zh: 她把周五我错过那节课的录播「链接」发给了我。

examples.en: The link in the group chat expires in two hours, so open it soon.
examples.zh: 群聊里的「链接」两小时后失效，尽快打开。

words.enDefinition: a square pattern you scan with a phone camera to open something

examples.en: Scan the QR code on the poster to join the club's group chat.
examples.zh: 扫描海报上的「二维码」就能加入社团群聊。

examples.en: The restaurant has a QR code on the table instead of paper menus.
examples.zh: 餐厅桌上放的是「二维码」，没有纸质菜单。

collocations: a QR code on the poster

words.enDefinition: a phone or internet call where you can see each other

examples.en: We do a weekly video call with my parents so they can see the dorm.
examples.zh: 我们每周和爸妈「视频通话」，让他们看看我的宿舍。

examples.en: Can we switch this video call to audio? My roommate is sleeping.
examples.zh: 这通「视频通话」能改成语音吗？我室友在睡觉。

words.enDefinition: a recorded voice message left when someone does not answer

examples.en: I left a voicemail with the clinic, but they only return calls in the morning.
examples.zh: 我给诊所留了「语音留言」，但他们只在早上回电。

examples.en: My voicemail box is full, so new callers cannot leave messages anymore.
examples.zh: 我的「语音留言」信箱满了，新来电者没法再留言。

words.enDefinition: a call that rang but was not answered in time

examples.en: I had three missed calls from my advisor, so I called back right away.
examples.zh: 我看到三个导师打来的「未接来电」，马上回了过去。

examples.en: The lock screen shows a missed call from an unknown campus number.
examples.zh: 锁屏上显示一个校园陌生号码打来的「未接来电」。

words.enDefinition: a mode that plays a call out loud without holding the phone

examples.en: Put the clinic on speakerphone so we can both hear the appointment options.
examples.zh: 把诊所来电开「免提」，这样咱俩都能听到预约选项。

examples.en: My roommate takes every call on speakerphone, which drives me crazy during naps.
examples.zh: 我室友打电话全开「免提」，我午睡时简直受不了。

words.enDefinition: the sound a phone makes when someone calls you

examples.en: My ringtone is still the default one because I never figured out how to change it.
examples.zh: 我的「手机铃声」还是默认的，因为一直没搞明白怎么换。

examples.en: His ringtone goes off in the library at the worst possible moment.
examples.zh: 他的「手机铃声」总在图书馆里最不该响的时候响起来。

words.enDefinition: shake gently instead of ringing to alert you quietly

examples.en: Set your phone to vibrate during the seminar so it never rings out loud.
examples.zh: 研讨会期间把手机调成「震动」，就不会突然响铃了。

examples.en: I set the alarm to vibrate so it wakes me without waking my roommate.
examples.zh: 我把闹钟调成「震动」，能叫醒自己又不吵到室友。

words.enDefinition: a phone setting that stops all rings and alert sounds

examples.en: My phone was on silent mode, so I missed your call this morning.
examples.zh: 我手机开了「静音模式」，今早没接到你的电话。

examples.en: Remember to switch to silent mode before you walk into the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 走进阶梯教室之前，记得切到「静音模式」。

words.enDefinition: a mode that silences calls and alerts during chosen times

examples.en: I turn on do not disturb every night at eleven so late texts wait until morning.
examples.zh: 每晚十一点我都会开启「勿扰模式」，深夜的消息留到早上再看。

examples.en: Do not disturb blocks every call except the favorites list.
examples.zh: 「勿扰模式」会拦截所有来电，只放行收藏的联系人。

collocations: do not disturb during study hours

words.enDefinition: a screen setting with dark backgrounds and lighter text

examples.en: Dark mode is easier on my eyes during late-night essay edits.
examples.zh: 深夜改论文时，「深色模式」对眼睛更友好。

examples.en: My phone switches to dark mode automatically at sunset every single day.
examples.zh: 每天日落时分，我的手机都会自动切换到「深色模式」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that turns off all wireless connections at once

examples.en: Switch on airplane mode during the flight and download movies beforehand.
examples.zh: 飞行途中开启「飞行模式」，记得提前把电影下载好。

examples.en: I leave airplane mode on at night, so my alarm still works but nothing else pings.
examples.zh: 晚上我一直开着「飞行模式」，闹钟照常响，其他消息一律不打扰。

words.enDefinition: the wireless network that connects devices to the internet

examples.en: The dorm wifi drops every evening when everyone streams shows at once.
examples.zh: 每晚大家同时看剧，宿舍的「无线网络」就会掉线。

examples.en: Ask at the counter for the wifi name and password before you order.
examples.zh: 点单前先到柜台问一下「无线网络」的名称和密码。

words.enDefinition: a short-range wireless connection between nearby devices

examples.en: Turn on bluetooth in the car so the GPS directions play through the speakers.
examples.zh: 在车里打开「蓝牙」，导航提示就能从音箱播出来。

examples.en: My bluetooth keeps disconnecting from my earbuds on the bus.
examples.zh: 坐公交时，我的「蓝牙」总是和耳机断开。

words.enDefinition: sharing a phone's mobile internet with other devices wirelessly

examples.en: The dorm wifi was down, so I shared my phone's hotspot with my roommate.
examples.zh: 宿舍WiFi挂了，我就把手机的「热点」分享给室友。

examples.en: I burn through my data fast whenever I use my hotspot for class.
examples.zh: 每次上课用手机「热点」，我的流量都烧得特别快。

words.enDefinition: satellite navigation that shows your location and gives directions

examples.en: The GPS sent us to the wrong entrance of the huge campus.
examples.zh: 「GPS导航」把我们带到了校园的错误入口。

examples.en: Keep your GPS on so I can track the shuttle you are taking.
examples.zh: 让你的「GPS导航」保持开启，我好查看你坐的班车位置。

words.enDefinition: save a note that alerts you at a chosen time

examples.en: Set a reminder for the rent deadline so you never pay it late.
examples.zh: 给交房租的截止日期「设置提醒」，就再也不会迟交了。

examples.en: I set a reminder to call my grandma every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 我给每周日晚上给奶奶打电话这件事「设置提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a battery-saving setting that limits background activity

examples.en: I switch on low power mode around dinner so my battery survives the night out.
examples.zh: 晚饭时分我会打开「低电量模式」，让电池撑过夜生活。

examples.en: Low power mode dims the screen and stops mail from refreshing constantly.
examples.zh: 「低电量模式」会调暗屏幕，并让邮件不再不停刷新。

words.enDefinition: delay the alarm for a few extra minutes of sleep

examples.en: I snooze my alarm exactly three times before dragging myself to morning class.
examples.zh: 上早课前我总会按三次「贪睡」，才勉强爬起来。

examples.en: Do not snooze the alarm again, or we will miss the free breakfast.
examples.zh: 别再按「贪睡」了，不然我们就赶不上免费早餐了。

words.enDefinition: a phone tool for tracking dates, events, and deadlines

examples.en: Put every deadline into your phone calendar at the start of the term.
examples.zh: 学期一开始就把所有截止日期录进手机「日历」。

examples.en: My calendar reminders pop up before each lab session so I never forget.
examples.zh: 每次实验课前我的「日历」提醒都会弹出，所以我从不忘记。

words.enDefinition: a written list of tasks you plan to finish

examples.en: My Monday to-do list has laundry, a lab report, and a dentist appointment.
examples.zh: 我周一的「待办清单」上有洗衣服、写实验报告和看牙医。

examples.en: I keep a to-do list app on my home screen so I see it first.
examples.zh: 我把「待办清单」应用放在主屏幕上，一打开手机就能看到。

words.enDefinition: messages sent and received through an electronic mail service

examples.en: Check your university email twice a day because professors send updates there.
examples.zh: 每天查两次学校的「电子邮件」，教授的通知都发在那里。

examples.en: I drafted the email to my landlord twice before sending the complaint about heating.
examples.zh: 投诉暖气问题之前，我给房东的「电子邮件」打了两遍草稿。

collocations: an email from the housing office

words.enDefinition: capture a picture of whatever is showing on the screen

examples.en: Take a screenshot of the confirmation page in case the website crashes later.
examples.zh: 把确认页面「截屏」保存下来，以防网站待会儿崩溃。

examples.en: I always take a screenshot of my grades before the portal updates again.
examples.zh: 在教务系统再次更新前，我总会先「截屏」保存成绩。

words.enDefinition: duplicate text or files and place them somewhere else

examples.en: Copy and paste the tracking number into the courier's website to follow the parcel.
examples.zh: 把快递单号「复制粘贴」到快递官网，就能追踪包裹。

examples.en: Do not just copy and paste my notes — rewrite them in your own words.
examples.zh: 别直接「复制粘贴」我的笔记，要用你自己的话重新整理。

words.enDefinition: press the secondary mouse button to open extra options

examples.en: Right-click the file and choose rename before uploading the assignment.
examples.zh: 上传作业之前，「右键点击」文件并选择重命名。

examples.en: On the lab computers you cannot right-click the desktop, so use the menu bar.
examples.zh: 机房的电脑不能对桌面「右键点击」，只能用菜单栏。

words.enDefinition: move a file by holding and releasing it over a new spot

examples.en: Drag and drop the PDF into the upload box instead of browsing for it.
examples.zh: 把PDF「拖放」到上传框里就行，不用一层层去找。

examples.en: You can drag and drop photos straight from your desktop into the chat.
examples.zh: 你可以直接把照片从桌面「拖放」进聊天窗口。

words.enDefinition: enter a phone number and start the call

examples.en: Dial the campus safety number and save it under favorites for emergencies.
examples.zh: 「拨打电话」给校园安全中心，并把它存进收藏以备急用。

examples.en: Dial the number on the flyer to book a viewing this weekend.
examples.zh: 「拨打电话」给传单上的号码，预约这个周末看房。

words.enDefinition: remove something permanently from your device or account

examples.en: Delete the duplicate photos after every trip to keep your storage sane.
examples.zh: 每次旅行后「删除」重复照片，免得存储爆满。

examples.en: I accidentally deleted my whole draft and nearly cried in the library.
examples.zh: 我不小心「删除」了整篇草稿，在图书馆差点哭出来。

words.enDefinition: store your work so it is kept after closing

examples.en: Save your essay to two places while you write, not just the desktop.
examples.zh: 写论文时就要把文章「保存」到两个地方，别只存桌面。

examples.en: The browser crashed before I could save my paragraph, and I lost ten minutes.
examples.zh: 浏览器崩了没来得及「保存」我的段落，十分钟白写了。

words.enDefinition: enter words using a keyboard

examples.en: I can type my notes faster than I can write them by hand now.
examples.zh: 现在我「打字」记笔记比手写快多了。

examples.en: Type the room number into the search bar and the map will guide you.
examples.zh: 在搜索框里「输入」房间号，地图就会带你过去。

words.enDefinition: open your phone by verifying it is really you

examples.en: My phone unlocks with my fingerprint, but I can also unlock it with the passcode.
examples.zh: 我的手机用指纹就行，也可以输密码「解锁」。

examples.en: Unlock the bike in the app by scanning the code on the handlebar.
examples.zh: 扫描车把上的二维码，就能在应用里「解锁」单车。

words.enDefinition: connect a device to power so its battery fills up

examples.en: Charge your phone before the field trip because we will take photos all day.
examples.zh: 实地考察前先把手机「充电」，因为我们要拍一整天照片。

examples.en: I charge my laptop in the library because my dorm outlet is behind the bed.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆给笔记本「充电」，因为宿舍插座在床后面够不着。

words.enDefinition: stop a caller or texter from contacting you again

examples.en: I finally blocked a number — the car insurance one that called every afternoon.
examples.zh: 我终于「屏蔽号码」了——就是那个每天下午打来的车险推销电话。

examples.en: Block a number immediately if it texts you about a package you never ordered.
examples.zh: 如果陌生号码发来你从没订过的包裹信息，立刻「屏蔽号码」。

collocations: block a number on your phone

words.enDefinition: close an app immediately when it stops responding

examples.en: Force quit the app and reopen it if the video stops loading halfway.
examples.zh: 如果视频放到一半不加载了，就「强制退出」应用再重新打开。

examples.en: I had to force quit the whole browser because one tab froze everything.
examples.zh: 一个标签页把一切都卡死了，我只好「强制退出」整个浏览器。

words.enDefinition: remove files to make room for new storage

examples.en: Free up space by deleting old lecture recordings you never rewatch.
examples.zh: 删掉从不回看的旧课堂录音，来「清理存储空间」。

examples.en: Free up space on your laptop before you install the new design software.
examples.zh: 安装新的设计软件之前，先给笔记本「清理存储空间」。

collocations: free up space on your phone

words.enDefinition: connect two devices wirelessly for the first time

examples.en: Pair your earbuds with the new phone by holding the button on the case.
examples.zh: 按住充电盒上的按钮，就能把耳机和新手机「配对」。

examples.en: My earbuds refuse to pair whenever the bluetooth setting gets switched off.
examples.zh: 只要蓝牙设置被关掉，我的耳机就没法「配对」。

words.enDefinition: move old messages or files into long-term storage without deleting

examples.en: Archive old club emails instead of deleting them in case you need receipts.
examples.zh: 把社团的旧邮件「归档」而不是删除，留着以后对账用。

examples.en: I archive every assignment confirmation email the moment I get it.
examples.zh: 每收到一封作业确认邮件，我就立刻「归档」。

words.enDefinition: cancel a mailing list so you stop receiving its emails

examples.en: Unsubscribe from the bookstore's emails or your inbox will drown in discount codes.
examples.zh: 赶紧「退订」书店的邮件，不然你的收件箱会被优惠码淹没。

examples.en: Scroll to the bottom of the newsletter and click unsubscribe to stop the daily blasts.
examples.zh: 滚动到新闻邮件底部，点击「退订」，不再每天被轰炸。

words.enDefinition: answer the sender and everyone else on the email

examples.en: Do not reply all to the professor's announcement; the whole class sees it.
examples.zh: 教授发的通知别「回复全部」，全班都看得见。

examples.en: Someone replied all with a meme, and the thread grew to eighty emails.
examples.zh: 有人「回复全部」发了个梗图，邮件串涨到八十封。

words.enDefinition: the short title at the top of an email

examples.en: Put your course code in the subject line so the professor finds your email fast.
examples.zh: 在「邮件主题」里写上课号，教授就能更快找到你的邮件。

examples.en: A clear subject line like 'Question about Essay 2' gets replies sooner.
examples.zh: 像“Essay 2 的问题”这样清楚的「邮件主题」，能更快得到回复。

words.enDefinition: unwanted advertising emails automatically filtered into a separate folder

examples.en: My scholarship offer email sat in junk mail for a whole week.
examples.zh: 奖学金录取邮件在「垃圾邮件」里躺了整整一周。

examples.en: Check junk mail before you assume the housing office never replied.
examples.zh: 别急着断定住宿办公室没回复，先查查「垃圾邮件」。

words.enDefinition: the core software that runs a phone or computer

examples.en: The new operating system made my three-year-old laptop feel sluggish.
examples.zh: 新的「操作系统」让我用了三年的笔记本变得反应迟钝。

examples.en: Update your operating system through settings, then restart before installing anything else.
examples.zh: 在设置里更新「操作系统」，装其他东西之前先重启一次。

collocations: your operating system is out of date

words.enDefinition: a website that finds pages matching the words you type

examples.en: I use a different search engine for school research because it shows academic sources first.
examples.zh: 做学术研究我用另一个「搜索引擎」，它会优先显示学术来源。

examples.en: Type the exact error message into the search engine and a fix usually appears.
examples.zh: 把报错信息原样输进「搜索引擎」，通常就能找到解决办法。

words.enDefinition: the camera on the screen side used for selfies and video calls

examples.en: The front camera is perfect for quick selfies between classes.
examples.zh: 课间用「前置摄像头」随手自拍非常方便。

examples.en: My front camera is smudged, so every video call looks slightly blurry.
examples.zh: 我的「前置摄像头」沾了指纹，视频通话画面总有点糊。

words.enDefinition: the digits people dial to reach your phone

examples.en: Write your phone number on the lab signup sheet next to your student ID.
examples.zh: 在实验登记表上你的学号旁边写下「电话号码」。

examples.en: Give me your phone number so the group can reach you about the project.
examples.zh: 把「电话号码」给我，小组有事好联系你。

words.enDefinition: having no room left to save files or photos

examples.en: My phone is out of storage, so I cannot even download the reading PDF.
examples.zh: 我手机「存储空间不足」，连阅读PDF都下载不了。

examples.en: The camera refused to record because the laptop was out of storage.
examples.zh: 笔记本「存储空间不足」，相机都没法录像了。

collocations: the phone is out of storage

words.enDefinition: a battery completely drained, leaving the device unpowered

examples.en: My dead battery left me without maps in the middle of the move.
examples.zh: 「电池没电」让我搬家搬到一半就没地图可用。

examples.en: A dead battery is the real reason I missed the group meeting, honestly.
examples.zh: 说实话，错过小组会的真正原因就是「电池没电」。

collocations: a phone with a dead battery

words.enDefinition: very little charge remaining, usually with a warning alert

examples.en: My phone gave a low battery warning right before the professor called on me.
examples.zh: 教授刚要点我名，手机就弹出了「电量不足」警告。

examples.en: I carry a power bank everywhere because low battery anxiety is real.
examples.zh: 「电量不足」焦虑是真的，所以我走到哪都带着充电宝。

words.enDefinition: an internet connection that loads pages and videos slowly

examples.en: Slow internet in the dorm makes uploading my lab video take an hour.
examples.zh: 宿舍「网速慢」，上传实验视频要花一个小时。

examples.en: The cafe has slow internet, but the quiet is worth it for reading.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆「网速慢」，但很安静，值得来读书。

collocations: the slow internet in the dorm

words.enDefinition: an internet connection that keeps cutting in and out

examples.en: The spotty connection in the basement kicked me off the online quiz twice.
examples.zh: 地下室「网络不稳定」，我两次被踢下线，线上测验都做不了。

examples.en: A spotty connection makes video calls sound like a robot voice.
examples.zh: 「网络不稳定」的时候，视频通话听起来像机器人在说话。

collocations: a spotty connection in the basement

words.enDefinition: low network bars that make calls and texts unreliable

examples.en: The weak signal in the elevator means my texts will not send.
examples.zh: 电梯里「信号弱」，短信都发不出去。

examples.en: There is a weak signal near the back stairs, so calls cut off there.
examples.zh: 后楼梯附近「信号弱」，电话打到那儿就会断。

words.enDefinition: having no mobile network bars on the phone at all

examples.en: My phone shows no service in the basement laundry room of my dorm.
examples.zh: 在宿舍的地下洗衣房，我的手机显示「无服务」。

examples.en: No service for two days made me realize how often I check my phone.
examples.zh: 两天「无服务」让我意识到自己看手机有多频繁。

words.enDefinition: an area where phones get no signal at all

examples.en: The fourth-floor study lounge is a total dead zone for phone calls.
examples.zh: 四楼自习室是个「信号盲区」，打电话完全没戏。

examples.en: Every campus has one dead zone where group texts just never arrive.
examples.zh: 每个校园都有一个「信号盲区」，群消息永远收不到。

collocations: the dead zone in the library
calls drop in the dead zone

words.enDefinition: a phone call that suddenly cuts off mid-conversation

examples.en: We lost the clinic's number after a dropped call, so we booked online instead.
examples.zh: 一次「通话中断」之后我们找不到诊所号码了，只好改成网上预约。

examples.en: Dropped calls happen all the time here whenever the rain gets heavy.
examples.zh: 这里雨一大，就经常发生「通话中断」。

collocations: a dropped call in the middle

words.enDefinition: pausing to load a video when the internet is slow

examples.en: Constant buffering ruined the movie night in our common room.
examples.zh: 一直「缓冲」，把我们公共休息室的电影之夜毁了。

examples.en: The video keeps buffering right at the slide the professor said would be on the exam.
examples.zh: 视频偏偏在教授说必考的那一页一直「缓冲」。

collocations: buffering in the middle of a show

words.enDefinition: a delay between what you do and what the screen shows

examples.en: There is a half-second lag between my typing and the screen.
examples.zh: 我打字和屏幕显示之间有半秒的「卡顿」。

examples.en: The lag is so bad in the dorms that our team always loses.
examples.zh: 宿舍里「卡顿」太严重，我们队总是输。

collocations: the lag between input and screen

words.enDefinition: stop working suddenly, as an app does when overloaded

examples.en: The notes app crashed right before I saved my summary of chapter five.
examples.zh: 笔记应用在我保存第五章总结前突然「崩溃」了。

examples.en: Zoom tends to crash when forty students join the review session at once.
examples.zh: 四十个学生同时进复习课的时候，Zoom 容易「崩溃」。

words.enDefinition: a screen that stops responding to any touch

examples.en: A frozen screen in the middle of my presentation was my worst nightmare.
examples.zh: 演讲中途遇到「死机」是我最糟糕的噩梦。

examples.en: Tap the power and volume buttons together if you get a frozen screen.
examples.zh: 如果遇到「死机」，就同时按住电源键和音量键。

collocations: a frozen screen during the presentation

words.enDefinition: a small temporary fault in how software behaves

examples.en: A small glitch in the portal showed my grade as 300 percent.
examples.zh: 教务系统的一个「小故障」把我的成绩显示成了300%。

examples.en: The app update fixed the glitch that duplicated every photo I took.
examples.zh: 应用更新修复了让我每张照片都重复出现的「小故障」。

words.enDefinition: an error in a program's code that causes wrong behavior

examples.en: There is a bug where my deleted emails return the next morning.
examples.zh: 有个「程序错误」，我删掉的邮件第二天早上又回来了。

examples.en: The developer asked us to describe the bug step by step in the report.
examples.zh: 开发者请我们在报告里一步一步描述这个「程序错误」。

words.enDefinition: a small window that suddenly appears over what you are viewing

examples.en: A pop-up offered me 20 percent off right when I was about to check out.
examples.zh: 我正要结账，就弹出一个打八折的「弹窗」。

examples.en: Close every pop-up carefully so you do not accidentally agree to something weird.
examples.zh: 关「弹窗」时要小心，别一不小心同意了什么奇怪条款。

words.enDefinition: become dangerously hot after long use or charging

examples.en: My laptop overheats whenever I run the design software with twenty browser tabs.
examples.zh: 开着设计软件再挂二十个网页，我的笔记本就会「发烫」。

examples.en: Your phone overheats fast under a blanket, so leave it on the desk while charging.
examples.zh: 手机在被窝里很容易「发烫」，充电时还是放在桌上吧。

words.enDefinition: an unwanted call from telemarketers or recorded robots

examples.en: I get a spam call about student loans at least twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周至少接到两个关于学生贷款的「骚扰电话」。

examples.en: Answering one spam call apparently signs you up for five more.
examples.zh: 据说接了一个「骚扰电话」，之后就会有五个打进来。

words.enDefinition: not connected to the internet or a network right now

examples.en: The study app shows your flashcards offline, which saves data on the bus.
examples.zh: 这个学习应用支持「离线」看单词卡，坐公交不费流量。

examples.en: I went offline for the weekend and my inbox hated me on Monday.
examples.zh: 周末我「离线」了两天，周一的收件箱惨不忍睹。

words.enDefinition: link to the network again after losing connection

examples.en: The dorm wifi logs everyone out, and you must reconnect each morning.
examples.zh: 宿舍WiFi会把所有人登出，每天早上都得「重新连接」。

examples.en: Reconnect your earbuds by putting them back in the case for five seconds.
examples.zh: 把耳机放回充电盒五秒钟，就能「重新连接」。

words.enDefinition: save your document automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: This editor will auto-save your notes every thirty seconds or so.
examples.zh: 这个编辑器每隔三十秒左右就会「自动保存」一次笔记。

examples.en: Turn on auto-save in settings or you will lose work like I did.
examples.zh: 在设置里开启「自动保存」，不然会像我一样白白丢掉成果。
